name: runar
description: TypeScript-to-Bitcoin Script compiler for BSV smart contracts

scripts.test:all: pnpm run test && pnpm run test:root && pnpm run conformance:all && pnpm run examples:all && pnpm run e2e:all && pnpm run wallet-client:all
scripts.test:ci: pnpm run lint:silent-skips && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:all && RUNAR_INTEGRATION_STRICT=1 pnpm run integration:all && RUNAR_LEAN_STRICT=1 pnpm run lean:verify && pnpm run test:ci-local
scripts.conformance:ts: cd conformance && npx tsx runner/index.ts --tests-dir tests
scripts.conformance:rust: cd compilers/rust && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo test --test compiler_tests
scripts.conformance:multi: cd conformance && npx tsx runner/index.ts --tests-dir tests --multi-format
scripts.conformance:multi:fold-on: cd conformance && RUNAR_DISABLE_CONSTANT_FOLDING=0 npx tsx runner/index.ts --tests-dir tests --multi-format
scripts.conformance:parser-only: cd conformance && npx tsx runner/index.ts --tests-dir tests --parser-only
scripts.conformance:all: pnpm run conformance:allowlist-audit && pnpm run conformance:construct-ledger && pnpm run conformance:bip143-fixture-locktime && pnpm run conformance:ts && pnpm run conformance:go && pnpm run conformance:rust && pnpm run conformance:python && pnpm run conformance:zig && pnpm run conformance:ruby && pnpm run conformance:java && pnpm run conformance:parser-only && pnpm run conformance:multi && pnpm run conformance:multi:fold-on && pnpm run conformance:sdk && pnpm run conformance:anf-parity && pnpm run conformance:anf-parity:strict && pnpm run conformance:anf-parity:real-crypto
scripts.fuzz:ir:native: cd conformance && npx tsx fuzzer/index.ts --ir --hex --render native
scripts.examples:ts: npx vitest run examples/ts examples/sol examples/move
scripts.examples:all: pnpm run examples:ts && pnpm run examples:go && pnpm run examples:rust && pnpm run examples:python && pnpm run examples:zig && pnpm run examples:ruby && pnpm run examples:java
scripts.e2e:ruby: cd examples/end2end-example/ruby && bundle exec rspec price_bet_spec.rb --format documentation
scripts.e2e:all: pnpm run e2e:ts && pnpm run e2e:go && pnpm run e2e:rust && pnpm run e2e:python && pnpm run e2e:zig && pnpm run e2e:ruby && pnpm run e2e:java
scripts.integration:teranode: cd integration/go && NODE_TYPE=teranode go test -tags integration -v -timeout 600s
scripts.integration:teranode:run: cd integration && ./teranode.sh clean && ./teranode.sh start && cd go && NODE_TYPE=teranode go test -tags integration -v -timeout 600s; rc=$?; cd .. && ./teranode.sh stop; exit $rc
scripts.integration:python: cd integration/python && ([ -d .venv ] || (python3.13 -m venv .venv 2>/dev/null || python3 -m venv .venv) && .venv/bin/pip install -q -r requirements.txt) && PYTHONPATH=../../compilers/python:../../packages/runar-py .venv/bin/pytest -v
scripts.integration:ruby: cd integration/ruby && bundle exec rspec --format documentation
scripts.wallet-client:ts: cd packages/runar-sdk && npx vitest run src/__tests__/wallet-client.spec.ts
scripts.wallet-client:ruby: cd integration/ruby && bundle exec rspec spec/wallet_client_spec.rb --format documentation
scripts.wallet-client:all: pnpm run wallet-client:ts && pnpm run wallet-client:go && pnpm run wallet-client:rust && pnpm run wallet-client:python && pnpm run wallet-client:zig && pnpm run wallet-client:ruby && pnpm run wallet-client:java
scripts.decompiler:fingerprints:check: pnpm --filter runar-decompiler run fingerprints:build && git diff --quiet -- packages/decompiler/fingerprints.json || (echo 'fingerprints.json drift — run pnpm run decompiler:fingerprints:check and commit' && exit 1)
scripts.decompiler:templates:check: pnpm --filter runar-decompiler run templates:build && git diff --quiet -- packages/decompiler/templates-data.json || (echo 'templates-data.json drift — run pnpm run decompiler:templates:check and commit' && exit 1)
scripts.ci-local:python-compiler-test: cd compilers/python && PYTHONPATH=../../packages/runar-py python3 -m pytest tests -v
scripts.ci-local:ruby-compiler-test: cd compilers/ruby && bundle exec rake test
scripts.ci-local:conformance-misc-vitest: npx vitest run conformance/anf-scope.test.ts conformance/corpus-completeness.test.ts conformance/go-only-executing-coverage.test.ts conformance/fixture-count-doc.test.ts conformance/split-stack-desync.test.ts conformance/ci-predicate-sweep.test.ts conformance/state-shape-witnesses.test.ts conformance/codepart-pin conformance/dce conformance/source-map conformance/subtype-parity conformance/sdk-vertical conformance/sdk-call conformance/sdk-output/runner/sdk-runner-refusal-build-isolation.test.ts conformance/sdk-output/runner/sdk-runner-stale-tool.test.ts conformance/sdk-output/runner/sdk-output-coverage-audit.test.ts conformance/runner/__tests__ conformance/anf-interpreter/num2bin-engine-parity.test.ts conformance/anf-interpreter/driver-gate.test.ts conformance/wire-primitives.test.ts conformance/analyzer/__tests__ conformance/ir-roundtrip conformance/fuzz-regressions
scripts.ci-local:conformance-negatives: cd conformance && npx vitest run negatives
scripts.ci-local:conformance-go-only-parity: cd conformance && npx vitest run go-only-parity
scripts.ci-local:conformance-closed-findings: cd conformance && npx vitest run closed-findings
scripts.ci-local:conformance-preimage-binding: cd conformance && npx vitest run preimage-binding
scripts.ci-local:conformance-witnesses: cd conformance && npx vitest run witnesses
scripts.ci-local:fuzz-replay-check-no-deletions: cd conformance && npx tsx fuzz-regressions/replay.ts --check-no-deletions --base origin/main
scripts.ci-local:source-map-live-runner: out=$(mktemp) && npx tsx conformance/source-map/run.ts > "$out" 2>&1; rc=$?; cat "$out"; test $rc -eq 0 && ! grep -Eq ' SKIP( |$)' "$out"
